settings.reassurance: Handmade to order in the UK. Free, tracked and insured UK delivery.
settings.pdx_acc_delivery:
Each bracelet is handmade to order in the UK and delivered free, fully insured.

As every bracelet is made to order, and its diamonds and other stones are sourced individually for that piece, returns are not offered, except in the case of a manufacturing defect.
settings.pdx_acc_ethics: Every bracelet is independently hallmarked and supplied with a certificate of authenticity. Ethically sourced, independently certified, fairly priced.
